nebbia-strokes.json - stroke medians for Folia's 雾笺 (Nebbia) lyric style

Derived from AnimCJK <https://github.com/parsimonhi/animCJK>, commit 99dba566b92daf45ae20d05e6c91d3f68d8619f2.
AnimCJK - Copyright 2016-2026 - FM&SH. Its graphics data derive from the Arphic PL KaitiM
GB / Big5 fonts and the Makemeahanzi project; see COPYING.txt.

Modified on 2026-10-30 by the Folia project from AnimCJK <https://github.com/parsimonhi/animCJK> commit 99dba566b92daf45ae20d05e6c91d3f68d8619f2 (graphicsJaKana.txt, graphicsZhHans.txt, graphicsJa.txt): only the "medians" of each character are kept, outlines and other fields are dropped; y is flipped to point down (y' = 900 - y, a 1024 grid); strokes outside the grid (kana animation helpers) are removed; a character in more than one file is taken from the first of them in the order above. Distributed under the Arphic Public License, see licenses/nebbia-strokes/ARPHICPL.TXT and COPYING.txt.

The graphics text files this is made from are licensed by AnimCJK under the Arphic Public
License only (ARPHICPL.TXT), and so is this file. The program that produces it from those
files is dev/nebbia/nebbiaStrokesPlugin.mjs in the Folia repository
<https://github.com/chthollyphile/folia-major>.
